references.text: Joshua describes Laish (Leshem) as a city conquered by the tribe of Dan and renamed Dan, confirming the geographical location mentioned in Judges.
Joshua recounts the tribe of Dan's conquest of Leshem and its renaming to Dan, which parallels the account in Judges 18.
Beth-Rehob is mentioned here as an area linked to Sidon, confirming the geographical location of the valley noted in Judges 18:28.
Beth-Rehob is named as a place from where the Arameans came, pointing to the same geographical region found in Judges.
The description of Laish as isolated from Sidon and having no connection with other peoples provides context for why the city was vulnerable to attack.
